TopicEntityTag.description: One curated or machine-generated assertion that a reference is about a topic, optionally tied to a specific entity. The topic, entity_type, display_tag, data_novelty, and data_context values are ATP ontology curies; species is an NCBITaxon curie; entity is a MOD entity curie resolved through the Alliance persistent store.

confidence_level.description: Classifier confidence bucket for machine-generated tags (in practice high / medium / low, compared case-insensitively).

confidence_score.description: Classifier confidence score for machine-generated tags.

data_context.description: ATP curie stating what kind of data the tag represents, one of four disjoint terms: ATP:0000325 (experimentally studied data), ATP:0000360 (background information), ATP:0000328 (expression marker), ATP:0000327 (genetic marker). SCRUM-5697; added by migration d7b3e1c95a24 (2026-08-31). Required in the application model, but nullable in the database until the backfill completes -- and not yet present in every environment (e.g. literature-4006), so index generation must tolerate its absence.

data_novelty.description: ATP curie stating whether the tagged data is novel: ATP:0000334 (existing data), or a new-data term -- ATP:0000335 (new data) and its descendants ATP:0000321 (new data type), ATP:0000228 (new to database), ATP:0000229 (new to field).

date_created.description: When the row was created (stored UTC).

date_updated.description: When the row was last updated (stored UTC).

display_tag.description: ATP curie of the MOD display section the tag appears under on the public reference pages (e.g. ATP:0000147 primary display, ATP:0000130 review display).

entity.description: Curie of the tagged entity (e.g. SGD:S000002284, ZFIN:ZDB-ALT-...), resolved via the Alliance persistent store per entity_id_validation.

entity_id_validation.description: How the entity curie was validated, e.g. "alliance". Present exactly when entity is present.

entity_type.description: ATP curie of the kind of entity tagged (e.g. ATP:0000005 gene, ATP:0000006 allele, ATP:0000027 strain). Present exactly when entity is present.

ml_model_id.description: Foreign key to the ml_model that produced a machine-generated tag; absent for manual tags.

negated.description: True when the tag asserts the reference is NOT about the topic/entity.

note.description: Free-text curator note on the tag.

reference_curie.description: The AGRKB curie of the tagged reference (e.g. AGRKB:101000000860007); the join of reference_id exposed by the API and the search index, and the usable reference key for public consumers.

reference_id.description: Internal foreign key to the reference table; may be omitted in public TET documents, which key on reference_curie.

source.description: The tag's TopicEntityTagSource embedded inline -- for documents (e.g. the public search index) that carry the source's evidence assertion, method, and data providers next to the tag instead of joining on topic_entity_tag_source_id. When present it is the row topic_entity_tag_source_id points at.

species.description: NCBITaxon curie of the species the tag applies to.

topic.description: ATP curie of the topic asserted for the reference (A-team ontology term id), e.g. ATP:0000005 (gene) for a pure entity tag or a descendant of ATP:0000002 for a subject topic.

topic_entity_tag_id.description: Primary key of the topic_entity_tag row.

topic_entity_tag_source_id.description: Foreign key to the tag's TopicEntityTagSource.

validated_by.description: topic_entity_tag_ids of the tags validating this tag (the topic_entity_tag_validation association table).

validation_by_author.description: Rollup of author validations of this tag, computed from the validating tags.

validation_by_professional_biocurator.description: Rollup of professional-biocurator validations of this tag, computed from the validating tags.

TopicEntityTag.title: TopicEntityTag

TopicEntityTagSource.description: Where a family of tags comes from: the combination of evidence assertion, method, and data providers. Unique on (source_evidence_assertion, source_method, data_provider, secondary_data_provider).

data_provider.description: MOD abbreviation of the group that generated the tags (e.g. SGD).

date_created.description: When the row was created (stored UTC).

date_updated.description: When the row was last updated (stored UTC).

secondary_data_provider_abbreviation.description: MOD abbreviation of the Alliance member responsible for the data (mod.abbreviation behind secondary_data_provider_id).

source_evidence_assertion.description: ATP curie of the evidence assertion type, e.g. ATP:0000036 (assertion by professional biocurator), ATP:0000035 (author assertion), or an ML-method term for classifiers.

source_method.description: The system or pipeline that produced the tags, e.g. abc_literature_system, sgd_reference_curation, abc_entity_extractor.

topic_entity_tag_source_id.description: Primary key of the topic_entity_tag_source row.

validation_type.description: How tags from this source validate others (e.g. professional_biocurator, author); null for sources whose tags do not validate.

TopicEntityTagSource.title: TopicEntityTagSource

ValidationValueEnum.description: Computed validation rollup values (see calculate_validation_value_for_tag in topic_entity_tag_crud).
ValidationValueEnum.title: ValidationValueEnum
